scope: Isolated Edge; synthetic page images and vision API only. No user profile or credentials accessed.

results.name: Caption identities reject in-text references and accept supplementary and Chinese labels
Untrusted AI JSON, invalid coordinates and mismatched labels are rejected without execution
Coordinate normalization preserves fractional, declared pixel and xyxy geometry; roundoff is bounded and bad crops do not discard valid crops
Local extraction does not invoke AI, excludes anonymous graphics and leads to gallery supplementation
Partly invalid pages retain valid candidates without extra requests; retry targets only reported problem pages
An unusable format is corrected once with the same page and explicit dimensions before preview
A page still invalid after one correction is reported while later valid pages remain reviewable
HTTP failure stops subsequent pages without a correction request and retains earlier candidates for explicit review
Inferred corner coordinates are visibly marked and require manual selection; cancel returns to the gallery
Stopping the corrective request cancels it and prevents preview or further pages
Unified workbench collapses to a single row and preserves PDF reading space even with AI options open
Page range validation prevents requests before any page is transmitted
AI receives only explicitly selected pages; crops wait for visible preview confirmation
Duplicate AI reruns preserve existing crops and analyses, adding only confirmed missing candidates
Unnamed or misnumbered AI boxes cannot duplicate previously captured figures and tables
AI controls and crop preview fit a narrow viewport without horizontal overflow
Changed named crop requires explicit replacement selection
Unusable responses after bounded correction and HTTP 401 retain existing crops and actionable reports
Stopping a stalled AI call cancels its API request and releases extraction controls
Changing the AI configuration dismisses an unconfirmed preview and keeps existing crops
PDF all-figure question selects in one action, sends nothing before submit and synthesizes all five readings
Stopping all-figure PDF question aborts the current reading without remaining images or a synthesis call
All-figure PDF question stops on HTTP 401 and retains prior per-image results without synthesizing incomplete evidence
Document replacement cancels pending AI and prevents stale crops from entering the new document
Document replacement dismisses unconfirmed previews without retaining private page crops
No uncaught errors or unexpected network requests
